To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the capital structure of banks is positively associated with market power, profitability, size and tangibility and negatively related with risk and ownership.
the relationship between market power and capital is saucer shaped.
the capital structure of banks depends on market power, profitability, growth, size, tangibility, and risk.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of market power and capital structures on the performance of the Jordanian banking sector.
the relationship between capital structure and market structure and the relationship between capital structures and profitability.
the effect of capital structure on profitability and the relationship between capital structure and market structure in the Jordanian banking industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the relationship between capital structure and market conditions, agency cost and profitability is complex, and that the relationship between capital and market power is not linear.
, the relationship between market power, capital structure and profitability of Jordanian banks is not straightforward.
the market power and profitability are positively related to the capital structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the capital structure of banks is influenced by market conditions.
, the market power and profitability are the two most important variables that influence capital structure of Jordanian banks.
capital structure decisions are not only driven by the agency cost of debt, but also by the market power of the bank.
The main takeaway from our work is that
capital structure and bank performance are related to market power and profitability.
market conditions and agency problems play a role in the way banks choose their capital structure.
the relation between capital structure, market power and profitability is complex and depends on the range of market power.
